description.description: A 4-frame sequence showing a metallic, rusty object assembled from various mechanical parts. Frame 1 shows a base comprised of a gear and jagged, curved metal plates being assembled on the ground. Frame 2 is a close-up of a circular, rusted mechanical component with several bolt holes. Frame 3 shows a vertical column of segmented, interlocking parts. Frame 4 reveals a full character constructed from these parts, resembling Ironman, with a gear for a head and a rusted metal body, standing in a scrapyard-like environment.
